versions.changelog:
feishu-senseaudio-persona 1.0.0 – Initial release

- Enables a customizable persona-based voice companion skill for Feishu.
- Guides users to set up a virtual character’s profile (name, personality, style, voice) on first use.
- Responds to user messages (text or voice) as the configured persona, generating replies via persona-specific prompts.
- Synthesizes all voice replies using SenseAudio TTS, returning only Feishu-native OPUS audio messages (voice bars).
- Handles user speech input by transcribing with SenseAudio ASR before generating persona replies.
- Ensures strict compliance with using only SenseAudio for ASR/TTS and sending replies as voice messages, not text.
